title: App Factory 10x — Continuous Program
approved_scope: Strategic direction and backlog authorized; normal repo Product Bible, CI, reviews, credentials, privacy, release and Golden admission gates remain binding.
success_definition: 10x is a target, not a verified multiplier; measure lead time, verified deliveries, manual interventions, quality, user outcomes and revenue with baseline cohorts.

operating_rules.continuous_followup: scheduled audit may prioritize and execute authorized safe steps only when a real runner/Chat automation is available; no unbounded Chat self-resume.
operating_rules.risk_and_auth: One baseline per execution; correct exact-head check+review; no new billing, production deploy, Windows source import or Store publishing without separate gate
operating_rules.queue_exhaustion: Append W8+ before W7 completion; never recycle VERIFIED IDs; preserve history.

parallelism.execution_note: The selector returns all compatible READY tasks and defers conflicting writers, not a 3-task cap. Scheduler read-only summary does not launch coding jobs.
